values: Risk score and response priority are formula-driven from editable probability and impact inputs. High-risk items require an explicit owner and review cadence.
Authorized real-data DSN is unavailable, preventing point-in-time ranking and gate validation
Use deterministic fixture checks; log validation gap; schedule authorized-environment run before go/no-go
Point-in-time universe changes candidate selection or visibly lowers headline return
Pre-brief stakeholders; publish measurement rationale; compare candidates and holdout results
Abstention gate produces more no-recommendation states than product expectations
Define UX copy and decision policy; monitor trigger rate; never treat abstention as failure
Metric/API changes drift from FE labels or consumers
Version contract fixtures and run targeted API/FE regression suite
Warm-up enforcement changes early trades and causes unexpected result deltas
Add before/after fixture baselines; document expected early-window behavior
Release occurs without rollback evidence or disclosure of remaining limits
Require release checklist, rollback owner, and known-limitations sign-off
